method: External X11 keystrokes, same 1280x900 display and generated project committed into a clean Git working tree. Isolated app data/config/cache/home and unavailable session bus; no installed third-party extensions or AI generation. VS Code AI features and its TypeScript language-feature extension are disabled; Zed external language servers are disabled; Tributary agent discovery is disabled. Built-in language work and rendering backends differ. Warm OS page cache, 20 seconds settling after initial buffer verification. Picker visibility is observed through a changed top-center display region, then its exact query is confirmed through clipboard and its image is settled in 120ms polling intervals. Timings include these verification/settling costs; they are deliberately coarse workflow observations. Completion is checked by copying the actual source buffer/selected line through X11 clipboard, polling at 50ms with additional asynchronous clipboard overhead. These are coarse end-to-end navigation workflow observations, not frame/paint, exact input latency, cold startup, production p95 or semantic LSP throughput. Xvfb software graphics: Zed uses emulated Vulkan and warns of poor performance; this is not a hardware-GPU ranking. No debugger, profiler or forced GC. Failed small pilots are excluded; every final cohort case must pass. Large-file completion requires exact first and final nonempty source lines after native EOF navigation. Repeated same-buffer verification controls are recorded without subtracting them. App-tree PSS is sampled separately after work; reparented/external helpers, display-server allocations and GPU VRAM are outside its boundary.
